01-moed-mayaerne#3.heading: Hvad gjorde dem særlige?
01-moed-mayaerne#3.motif: Rendered in an authentic ancient Maya codex style on textured folded bark paper with strong black outlines and vibrant Maya blue and ochre washes. A high-ranking Maya scribe wearing an ornate feather headdress and jade ear spools sits in profile on a stone bench. He holds a folded codex manuscript, meticulously painting stylized symbols with a fine brush. Behind him rises a towering stepped pyramid temple against a deep dusk sky featuring a golden crescent moon and a bright Venus star. Beside the scribe sits a painted ceramic cylinder vessel. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top border.
01-moed-mayaerne#3.caption: En maya-skriver med fjerhovedprydelse maler i en foldebog foran et højt trappetempel under nattehimlen.
01-moed-mayaerne#3.alt: En maya-skriver sidder foran et højt tempel og maler i en foldebog.

01-moed-mayaerne#2.heading: Hvor og hvornår
01-moed-mayaerne#2.motif: In the flat, two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex on bark paper, three distinct landscapes of the Maya world are depicted together. On the left, tall stepped limestone temples rise above the lush canopy of the Petén rainforest. In the center, a Maya noble adorned in a jade necklace and quetzal-feather headdress stands beside a deep blue cenote set in the flat limestone terrain of the Yucatán. On the right, steep volcanic mountains reach up toward stylized cloud scrolls. The entire scene is framed at the top and bottom by traditional bands of decorative Maya calendrical glyphs painted in rich terracotta red and Maya blue.
01-moed-mayaerne#2.caption: Mayaernes landskaber med bjerge i syd, tæt regnskov i petén og flade kalkstenssletter i nord.
01-moed-mayaerne#2.alt: Maya-kodekstegning af tre landskaber med en hersker, pyramide, cenote og vulkanske bjerge.

01-moed-mayaerne#1.heading: Et folk, ikke et rige
01-moed-mayaerne#1.motif: Rendered in ancient Maya codex style on an aged paper background, two Maya kings (k'uhul ajaw) sit facing each other in profile on carved stone thrones draped in jaguar pelts. The king on the left wears an elaborate headdress featuring a coiled feather-serpent motif representing the Kaanul kingdom. The king on the right wears a towering headdress adorned with quetzal feathers and jade beads. Between them, stacked pottery jars of cacao, woven textiles, and bundles of obsidian blades represent trade and warfare between independent city-states. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the scene along the upper border, painted in traditional red, black, and Maya blue tones.
01-moed-mayaerne#1.caption: To maya-konger, k'uhul ajaw, mødes omgivet af handelsvarer og våben, der symboliserer alliance og rivalisering mellem bystaterne.
01-moed-mayaerne#1.alt: To maya-konger sidder over for hinanden i en klassisk maya-kodeksstil.

02-landet#5.heading: Landet bandt dem sammen
02-landet#5.motif: In the flat, highly stylized two-dimensional aesthetic of an ancient Maya codex, two Maya merchants meet at a riverbank where dense rainforest meets a winding blue waterway. On the left, a lowland merchant steps from a wooden dugout canoe carrying a carved terracotta bowl filled with cacao pods and a woven palm basket containing white salt crystals from the coast. On the right, a highland trader in a decorated loincloth and leather sandals kneels beside polished green jade beads and glossy black obsidian blades displayed on a woven mat. A wooden carrying frame laden with iridescent green quetzal feathers and a spotted jaguar pelt rests beside him. Stylized river currents and decorative glyphic cartouches frame the encounter.
02-landet#5.caption: Maya-handelsmænd udveksler kakao, salt, jade og obsidian ved en flodbred under deres rejse ad handelsruterne.
02-landet#5.alt: To Maya-handelsmænd bytter varer ved en flodbred i traditionel kodex-stil.

02-landet#4.heading: Højlandet: bjerge, vulkaner og jade
02-landet#4.motif: A Maya codex-style painting depicts the mist-shrouded highlands of Guatemala. In the background, two stylized volcanic peaks vent soft smoke into a sky framed by decorative calendar glyphs. In the foreground beside a winding river, a Maya merchant kneels before a craftsperson. The merchant holds out raw, unpolished green jade cobbles gathered from the riverbed, while the artisan displays freshly flaked, glossy black obsidian blades. Both figures wear traditional highland garments, including patterned woven textiles, simple sandals, and knotted fabric headbands. The scene is rendered in flat perspective with strong black outlines, using natural earth pigments of terracotta, jade green, ochre, and black.
02-landet#4.caption: Mayahandlende i højlandet bytter værdifuld grøn jade og skarp sort obsidian nær en vulkansk floddal.
02-landet#4.alt: Mayaer der handler med grønne jadesten og obsidianknive i et bjergrigt vulkanlandskab.

02-landet#3.heading: Det sydlige lavland: regnskoven
02-landet#3.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of a Maya codex, a colossal sacred ceiba tree dominates the scene, its roots extending into a stylized underworld river and its broad canopy reaching toward a band of celestial sky glyphs. A vibrant quetzal bird with long trailing green tail feathers perches among the upper branches, while a spotted jaguar stands at the tree base. In the background, a Classic Maya stepped pyramid rises above dense tropical jungle foliage next to a stone-lined water reservoir. The artwork features rich earth tones of Maya blue, terracotta red, jade green, and deep black outlines on a textured bark paper background.
02-landet#3.caption: Det hellige ceiba-træ hæver sig i den tætte regnskov sammen med en jaguar, quetzal-fugl og klassiske maya-pyramider.
02-landet#3.alt: Et helligt ceiba-træ omgivet af regnskovens dyr og maya-pyramider i kodeksstil.

02-landet#2.heading: Det nordlige lavland: kalksten og cenoter
02-landet#2.motif: A Maya codex-style scene depicting a sacred ritual at a cenote on the flat limestone landscape of the northern lowlands. Rendered in traditional two-dimensional painted codex art with dark outlines and warm earth tones, a high priest dressed in a jaguar skin loincloth and a towering green quetzal-feather headpiece stands at the brink of a circular sinkhole. He holds out a decorated ceramic bowl containing jade beads toward the clear blue water below. In the sky above, the rain god Chaak is drawn with his curling nose and lightning axe, amidst stylized raindrops and cloud glyphs.
02-landet#2.caption: En maya-præst giver ofringer af jade og keramik til regnguden Chaak ved en hellig cenote.
02-landet#2.alt: En maya-præst bringer ofringer til regnguden ved en dyb, rund cenote.

02-landet#1.heading: Et land på størrelse med Italien
02-landet#1.motif: In the style of a traditional Maya bark-paper codex with bold black outlines and Maya blue, red, and yellow washes, a tri-level landscape map illustrates the Maya region. The top register shows the flat limestone terrain of the northern lowlands with a circular cenote filled with clear turquoise water. The middle register depicts dense tropical rainforest of the southern lowlands with stone temples rising above the canopy. The bottom register presents steep volcanic highland mountains under misty skies. Decorative Maya glyphs line the border, while a seated Maya noble dressed in a feathered headdress holds a measuring cord.
02-landet#1.caption: Mayaområdets tre geografiske zoner vist i kodeks-stil: det nordlige lavland, det sydlige lavland og højlandet.
02-landet#1.alt: Kodeks-maleri af tre landskabstyper: fladt lavland med cenote, regnskov og bjergrigt højland.

03-begyndelsen#5.heading: En overraskelse fra luften
03-begyndelsen#5.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with warm terracotta, ochre, and sage hues, a wide communal earthen platform stretches across the scene at Aguada Fenix. Early Maya villagers, dressed in simple woven cotton loincloths, fiber skirts, and modest shell beads without royal regalia, work together. Some carry baskets of clay and stone up sloping earthen terraces, while a large group gathers on the summit around smoke rising from ceramic censers. Surrounding lush tropical palms and lowland vegetation frame the gathering under decorative Maya glyph borders along the top edge.
03-begyndelsen#5.caption: Mennesker samles og bygger den enorme jordplatform ved Aguada Fénix til fælles ceremonier i mayaernes tidlige historie.
03-begyndelsen#5.alt: Tidlige mayaer bygger og samles på en stor jordplatform i et kodex-maleri.

03-begyndelsen#4.heading: De første landsbyer
03-begyndelsen#4.motif: Rendered in the flat, calligraphic line-art style of an ancient Maya codex on folded amate paper. An early Preclassic Maya village scene unfolds along a riverbank in the lush lowlands. A simple oval dwelling stands prominently, featuring wattle-and-daub walls woven from branches and plastered with pale clay, topped with a steep roof of woven palm thatch. In the foreground, a woman wearing a simple unadorned cotton wrap kneels on a reed mat, shaping a smooth ceramic bowl from clay next to finished pottery jars. Nearby, a man works in a small maize plot using a wooden digging stick. Tropical foliage frames the backdrop beneath decorative Maya sky glyphs.
03-begyndelsen#4.caption: Et tidligt mayahus af lerklinet fletværk med palmetag, hvor beboerne fremstiller keramik og dyrker jorden.
03-begyndelsen#4.alt: Tidlig mayalandsby med lerklinet hus, palmetag og keramikfremstilling i et tropisk landskab.

03-begyndelsen#3.heading: Milpa – de tre søstre
03-begyndelsen#3.motif: In the flat, decorative style of an ancient Maya codex on amate bark paper, a Maya woman kneels on a woven mat before a three-legged stone metate. She wears a simple embroidered huipil and uses a cylindrical stone mano to grind softened maize kernels into smooth dough. Clay vessels containing limewater and cooked corn sit beside her. In the background, framed by stylized trees, a Maya farmer dressed in a cotton loincloth stands in a lush milpa field. Tall corn stalks support twining green bean vines, while large squash leaves carpet the fertile earth around their bases. Decorative Maya glyphs border the top of the scene.
03-begyndelsen#3.caption: En mayakvinde maler majs på en metate, mens en landmand passer sin milpa med majs, bønner og squash.
03-begyndelsen#3.alt: Mayakvinde maler majs på en sten, og en landmand arbejder i sin milpa.

03-begyndelsen#2.heading: Majsen
03-begyndelsen#2.motif: Rendered in the style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and earthy pigments, the Young Maize God emerges gracefully from a stylized, leafy maize stalk. He is depicted as a handsome young deity with an elongated head tapering into a ripe ear of corn, decorated with flowing maize silk and vibrant green jade beads. His headdress features delicate quetzal feathers resembling corn leaves. In one hand, he holds a bowl containing sacred maize seeds, while small stylized teosinte plants grow near his feet. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the scene on a warm, weathered parchment background.
03-begyndelsen#2.caption: Den unge majsgud stiger frem fra en majsplante, som beskrevet i mayaernes skabelsesberetning.
03-begyndelsen#2.alt: Mayaernes majsgud fremstillet med et majskolbeformet hoved i et klassisk kodeks-billede.

03-begyndelsen#1.heading: De første mennesker
03-begyndelsen#1.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex, early nomadic hunter-gatherers navigate a primeval Mesoamerican landscape. A man wearing a simple hide loincloth holds a wooden spear, watching wild deer near a stylized river rendered with curving turquoise lines. Nearby, a woman gathers wild fruits and roots into a woven reed basket beneath thick tropical foliage. In the river, another figure harvests fish with a small woven net. The scene is drawn with bold black linework and painted in earth tones of ochre, terracotta, and Maya blue. Decorative, stylized Mayan sky glyphs frame the upper border of the fold-out page.
03-begyndelsen#1.caption: Tidlige jægere og samlere i det mellemamerikanske landskab samler frugt, fisker og jager dyr.
03-begyndelsen#1.alt: Tidlige mennesker jager og samler mad ved en flod i maya-kodeksstil.

04-praeklassisk-tid#5.heading: En stor by forlades
04-praeklassisk-tid#5.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of a Maya codex, Maya families in Preclassic attire—simple cotton tunics, loincloths, and woven headbands—walk away from the grand triadic pyramids of El Mirador. The surrounding landscape shows felled trees, exposed soil, and dried-up lowlands under a pale sun. The people carry clay jars and woven baskets supported by forehead tumplines, migrating toward a distant horizon where the lush temples of Tikal emerge beneath stylized rain-cloud glyphs. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top border. The scene uses earthy ochre, rust-red, and black line work with subtle Maya blue highlights, capturing the drought-driven exodus and the dawn of a new era.
04-praeklassisk-tid#5.caption: Indbyggere forlader El Mirador under tørke og drager mod voksende byer som Tikal.
04-praeklassisk-tid#5.alt: Maya-familier vandrer væk fra en forladt pyramide mod en ny by.

04-praeklassisk-tid#4.heading: Den tidligste skrift og de første konger
04-praeklassisk-tid#4.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and earth tones of terracotta and red, a Preclassic Maya king kneels reverently before the seated Maize God. The king receives a royal ceremonial headband adorned with jade beads, marking the divine origin of early Mayan kingship. Beside them stand vertical columns of decorative early Mayan hieroglyphs, representing the earliest Maya script. In the background, polished green jade ornaments and dark obsidian blades are displayed on woven mats, symbolizing the trade wealth of early Preclassic cities like Kaminaljuyu and San Bartolo.
04-praeklassisk-tid#4.caption: En præklassisk maya-konge modtager sit herskersymbol foran Majsguden, inspireret af San Bartolo-vægmalerierne.
04-praeklassisk-tid#4.alt: En maya-konge bliver kronet foran Majsguden i klassisk maya-tegnestil.

04-praeklassisk-tid#3.heading: Veje gennem skoven
04-praeklassisk-tid#3.motif: In the style of a Maya codex, a wide, elevated stone causeway coated in bright white lime plaster cuts straight through a lush, humid jungle swamp. Maya travelers in Preclassic attire, wearing simple loincloths and sandals, carry woven baskets of goods using headbands. The causeway stretches from the foreground toward a distant triadic pyramid complex peeking above the rainforest canopy. The artwork features flat color fills, thick black linework, and stylized tropical foliage, surrounded by a border of traditional Maya day-glyphs.
04-praeklassisk-tid#3.caption: Maya-rejsende vandrer langs en bred, hvidpudset stenvej (sacbe), som skærer igennem den tætte jungle.
04-praeklassisk-tid#3.alt: Maya-rejsende på en hævet hvid stenvej gennem junglen.

04-praeklassisk-tid#2.heading: El Mirador – den store by i nord
04-praeklassisk-tid#2.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex, the monumental La Danta pyramid complex of El Mirador rises above the dense jungle canopy. The massive tiered platform is coated in smooth, brilliant white lime plaster, accented with deep red painted borders. Huge, deeply sculpted stucco masks depicting Maya deities with stylized fangs and circular ear spools adorn the facade of the pyramid tiers. At the very top, three smaller temples stand in a triadic formation. In the foreground, Preclassic Maya artisans with traditional tied hair, loincloths, and jade beads apply red mineral pigment to a large deity mask.
04-praeklassisk-tid#2.caption: Den kæmpemæssige La Danta-pyramide i El Mirador, udsmykket med røde stukmasker og triadiske templer på toppen.
04-praeklassisk-tid#2.alt: En hvid og rød trappepyramide med store gude-stukmasker i maya-kodeksstil.

04-praeklassisk-tid#1.heading: Fra landsby til by
04-praeklassisk-tid#1.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with bold outlines and mineral tones, an early Preclassic ceremonial plaza comes to life. On one side stands a long low plastered platform, and opposite it sits a modest step-pyramid. In the central open space, an Olmec trader wearing a rounded helmet and jaguar-skin loincloth offers a polished green jade celt to an early Maya chief. The Maya chief wears woven cotton clothing and a modest feather headdress. Woven mats display raw jade pieces and ceramic vessels between them. Decorative early iconographic glyphs border the top frame.
04-praeklassisk-tid#1.caption: Tidlige mayaer og olmekere udveksler jadesmykker på en nyanlagt ceremoniplads med pyramide og platform.
04-praeklassisk-tid#1.alt: Mayaer og olmekere handler med jade foran en tidlig ceremoniplads.

05-klassisk-tid#5.heading: Slutningen nærmer sig
05-klassisk-tid#5.motif: Rendered in an ancient Maya codex style on textured bark paper, a Maya stonemason kneels before an unfinished limestone stela carving, setting down his wooden mallet and stone chisel. The stela displays only half a carved ruler with unshaped Long Count glyphs at the base. Behind him, a grand stepped pyramid temple stands quiet under a pale yellow sky, with creeping jungle vines starting to climb its stone staircases. A nobleman wearing an ornate quetzal-feather headdress and jade ear spools turns his back to the palace plaza, walking toward the surrounding rainforest. Decorative Maya sky glyphs frame the top of the scene.
05-klassisk-tid#5.caption: En stenhugger efterlader sin ufuldendte stela, mens junglen langsomt overtager den forladte Maya-by.
05-klassisk-tid#5.alt: En Maya-stenhugger ved en ufuldendt stela foran en forladt pyramide i junglen.

05-klassisk-tid#4.heading: Andre kongeriger
05-klassisk-tid#4.motif: Rendered in two-dimensional Maya codex painting style with black outlines and earthy pigments, King K'inich Janaab Pakal sits in profile on a carved double-headed jaguar throne. He wears an intricate green jade mosaic mask, a heavy jade bead necklace, and a towering headdress of vibrant quetzal feathers. In his hand, he holds a ceremonial scepter. To his left stands a detailed Maya stone stela depicting a ruler in high relief, adorned with carved glyphs. In the background, the terraced roof comb of a Classic Period temple rises against a parchment-colored backdrop bordered by traditional decorative Maya glyph blocks.
05-klassisk-tid#4.caption: Kong Pakal af Palenque med sin berømte jademaske ved siden af en udskåret Copán-stela.
05-klassisk-tid#4.alt: Maya-konge med jademaske siddende på en trone ved en udskåret stensøjle.

05-klassisk-tid#3.heading: Tikal rejser sig igen
05-klassisk-tid#3.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex on aged amate paper, King Jasaw Chan K'awiil of Tikal stands triumphantly on a stone plaza. He wears a towering headdress adorned with shimmering green quetzal feathers, an elaborate jade collar, and an intricately woven loincloth. In one hand he holds a ceremonial scepter with a jaguar motif. Behind him looms the steep, terraced facade of Temple I with its tall roof comb under a stylized tropical sky. At his feet kneels a captive lord from the Snake Kingdom. Decorative hieroglyphic blocks frame the scene in black and red ink.
05-klassisk-tid#3.caption: Kong Jasaw Chan K'awiil af Tikal fejrer sejren over Calakmul foran det nyrejste Tempel I.
05-klassisk-tid#3.alt: Mayakongens sejrsfejring foran det høje tempel i Tikal i kodeksstil.

05-klassisk-tid#2.heading: Slangeriget og Tikal
05-klassisk-tid#2.motif: In the two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with bold outlines and earthy red washes, a powerful king of the Snake Kingdom sits on a jaguar-skin cushion atop a carved limestone platform. He wears a towering headdress of vibrant green quetzal feathers, a heavy jade pectoral, and holds a ceremonial serpent bar. Floating prominently near the throne is the carved Snake emblem glyph. In the tropical background, step pyramids rise above dense jungle foliage. Before the ruler, a defeated noble from Tikal kneels in submission, flanked by attendants offering jade beads and woven textiles as tribute.
05-klassisk-tid#2.caption: Slangerigets konge modtager hyldest og krigsfanger med Kaanul-rigets slangehieroglyf ved sin side.
05-klassisk-tid#2.alt: Maya-konge fra Slangeriget siddende på en trone i regnskoven omgivet af hieroglyffer og krigsfanger.

05-klassisk-tid#1.heading: Hellige konger
05-klassisk-tid#1.motif: A Classic Maya king, the k'uhul ajaw, stands in profile on a stone temple plaza dressed in lavish royal regalia. He wears a majestic headdress adorned with long quetzal feathers and jade beads, a patterned cotton loincloth, and heavy jade wrist cuffs. In his hands, he holds a ceremonial double-headed serpent bar symbolizing his divine role. Beside him stands a newly carved tall stone stele covered in detailed Maya hieroglyphic cartouches. Background features step-pyramid temples under a stylized sky with decorative Maya glyph borders. The scene is rendered in an authentic Maya codex painting style with dark outlines, flat perspective, and natural pigments on bark paper.
05-klassisk-tid#1.caption: En maya-konge i ceremoniel dragt står ved en nyligt udhugget stensøjle med hieroglyffer.
05-klassisk-tid#1.alt: En maya-konge står i fin dragt ved siden af en udskåret stensøjle.

06-hverdagsliv#6.heading: Skel mellem folk
06-hverdagsliv#6.motif: An ancient Maya codex style illustration depicting the distinct social hierarchy of Maya society. At the top of a stepped limestone pyramid, a Maya ruler adorned in an extravagant quetzal-feather crest, jade bead necklaces, and jaguar skin loincloth performs a ceremonial dance. Beside him stand high priests and scribes wearing elaborate animal masks and carrying folded bark paper codices. At the foot of the terrace, common Maya farmers wearing plain cotton loincloths and craftspeople carrying ceramic vessels and stone tools gather to observe the ritual. Decorative Maya hieroglyphs frame the scene painted on textured bark paper in red, ochre, and black pigments.
06-hverdagsliv#6.caption: Kongen og adelen står øverst på pyramiden, mens bønder og håndværkere samles nedenfor under en ceremoni.
06-hverdagsliv#6.alt: En maya-konge på en pyramide over for bønder og håndværkere i kodeks-stil.

06-hverdagsliv#5.heading: Skønhed
06-hverdagsliv#5.motif: Rendered in the classic Maya codex painting style with dark calligraphic outlines and rich pigments of Maya blue, ochre, and terracotta, an elite Maya noble sits in profile on a low bench inside a palace chamber. The noble displays an elongated, sloped forehead from cranial modification and wears an extravagant headdress adorned with towering green quetzal feathers and jade beads. Round jade ear spools pierce the earlobes, and fine geometric tattoos cover the shoulders. The noble smiles slightly, revealing filed teeth inlaid with tiny green jade stones, while a kneeling attendant holds up a polished black obsidian mirror.
06-hverdagsliv#5.caption: En maya-noble med kunstigt formet pande, jade-smykker og jadeindlagte tænder spejler sig i et obsidianspejl.
06-hverdagsliv#5.alt: Maya-noble med formet kranie, jadeøreringe og indlagte jadetænder kigger i et spejl.

06-hverdagsliv#4.heading: Arbejde og handel
06-hverdagsliv#4.motif: A vibrant Maya marketplace scene rendered in the flat, two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex. On the left, a woman wearing a patterned tunic kneels, operating a backstrap loom tied around her waist and attached to a tree trunk. In the center, a merchant sits among painted ceramic pots of maize porridge, woven baskets of tamales, and wrapped bundles of salt. On the right, a male porter wears a loincloth and uses a tumpline strap across his forehead to carry a heavy wooden frame packed with pottery on his back. Stylized Maya glyphs frame the scene at the top edge.
06-hverdagsliv#4.caption: Et maya-marked, hvor en kvinde væver bomuld, mens en handelsmand og en bærer udveksler varer.
06-hverdagsliv#4.alt: Et historisk maya-marked med en vævende kvinde, en handelsmand og en bærer.

06-hverdagsliv#3.heading: Mad og drikke
06-hverdagsliv#3.motif: Rendered in the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines on a warm parchment background, a noble Maya woman prepares a ceremonial cacao drink. She wears an embroidered cotton dress, jade ear spools, and a modest beaded headband. Standing beside a low wooden bench, she holds an elongated polychrome ceramic vessel high in the air, pouring a dark stream of cacao down into a matching cylinder on the floor to generate rich foam. Beside the bench sits a shallow basket filled with tamales wrapped in maize husks and dried chili peppers. Decorative Maya glyphs accent the upper margin.
06-hverdagsliv#3.caption: En maya-kvinde hælder kakao fra ét bæger til et andet for at skabe det eftertragtede skum.
06-hverdagsliv#3.alt: En maya-kvinde i kodeksstil hælder skummende kakaodrik mellem to keramiske bægere.

06-hverdagsliv#2.heading: Amerikas Pompeji
06-hverdagsliv#2.motif: In the stylized visual language of a Maya codex with rich red, yellow, and black earth tones, a humble farming village at Joya de Cerén is depicted. A thatched-roof house with wattle-and-daub walls stands beside raised garden beds growing maize, beans, and broad manioc leaves. Painted ceramic bowls containing traces of food, woven sleeping mats, and clay storage jars sit near the doorway. Soft, stylized streams of grey ash rain down from stylized clouds above, gently blanketing the roofs, fields, and household items. The scene captures everyday rural Maya life right at the moment of volcanic preservation.
06-hverdagsliv#2.caption: Landsbyen Joya de Cerén med huse, redskaber og afgrøder, som blev bevaret under et lag af vulkansk aske.
06-hverdagsliv#2.alt: En maya-landsby med stråtækte huse og afgrøder dækket af et lag vulkansk aske.

06-hverdagsliv#1.heading: Huset og gården
06-hverdagsliv#1.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and earth-toned washes, a family compound unfolds around a small clay courtyard. A traditional house made of wattle-and-daub with a steep palm-thatched roof rests on a low stone platform. An elderly man in a simple woven loincloth sits on a wooden bench, watching a woman weave cotton cloth on a backstrap loom anchored to a tree. Nearby, another woman kneels to grind maize on a stone metate. A cross-section beneath the platform floor reveals a peaceful ancestor wrapped in textiles, surrounded by decorative Mayan glyphs.
06-hverdagsliv#1.caption: En maya-familie arbejder i gården ved deres stråtækte hus på en lav platform af sten.
06-hverdagsliv#1.alt: Maya-familie i gårdspladsen ved et stråtækt hus, hvor en kvinde væver stof.

07-tro-og-ritualer#6.heading: Røgelse og forfædre
07-tro-og-ritualer#6.motif: A Maya priest stands in profile in the classic two-dimensional Maya codex style, wearing an elaborate quetzal feather headdress, jade bead necklace, and rich ceremonial loincloth. He places rounded lumps of copal resin into a sculpted ceramic incensario decorated with a deity face. Swirling clouds of stylized light blue smoke billow upward from the incense burner, curling through the upper band of the scene where ancestral faces emerge from stylized clouds. The artwork features bold black outlines, vibrant Maya blue, terracotta, and jade green pigments on an unrolled parchment background, framed by decorative Maya hieroglyphs along the top border.
07-tro-og-ritualer#6.caption: En mayapræst tilbyder vellugtende kopal-harpiks i et røgelserikar, hvor den blå røg stiger op mod guderne.
07-tro-og-ritualer#6.alt: Tegning i maya-codexstil af en præst, der brænder kopal-røgelse ved et alter.

07-tro-og-ritualer#5.heading: Boldspillet
07-tro-og-ritualer#5.motif: An ancient Maya codex illustration depicting a ballgame match. Two athletic Maya players are positioned on an alley-shaped ball court framed by sloped, red-painted stone walls. One player wears a thick padded leather waist yoke, knee guards, and a tall feather headdress as he dives to strike a large, solid black rubber ball with his hip. The opposing player stands ready in a guarded stance. Decorative Maya hieroglyphs line the top border. The style uses traditional codex aesthetics with strong black outlines, warm ochre tones, terracottas, and Maya blue washes on an aged bark paper texture.
07-tro-og-ritualer#5.caption: Mayaspillere rammer den tunge gummibold med hofterne på en traditionel boldbane.
07-tro-og-ritualer#5.alt: Mayaspillere i polstret udrustning på en boldbane.

07-tro-og-ritualer#4.heading: Blod til guderne
07-tro-og-ritualer#4.motif: Rendered in an ancient Maya codex style with bold black outlines and earthy pigments, Maya Queen K'abal Xook kneels on a patterned woven mat inside a stone temple chamber. She wears an intricate patterned huipil and heavy jade beads, holding a braided rope studded with thorns. Beside her, King Itzamnaaj Bahlam stands in a grand towering quetzal-feather headdress, holding a flaming torch that casts light across the ceremony. In front of them, a ceramic burner releases thick, stylized smoke coils that arch upward, taking the shape of a mystical Vision Serpent. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top edge.
07-tro-og-ritualer#4.caption: Dronning K'abal Xook og kong Itzamnaaj Bahlam udfører et blodofferritual for at fremkalde en visionsslange.
07-tro-og-ritualer#4.alt: Maya-dronning og konge ved et ritual med røg formet som en slange.

07-tro-og-ritualer#3.heading: Popol Vuh og heltetvillingerne
07-tro-og-ritualer#3.motif: In the flat, two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex painting on aged bark paper, the Hero Twins, Hunahpu and Xbalanque, play the sacred ballgame against the Lords of the Underworld. The twins wear leather ballgame yokes around their waists, padded knee guards, and elaborate feather headdresses depicting animal spirits. They vault across a stepped I-shaped court, bouncing a heavy black rubber ball. Opposite them stand the Lords of Xibalba, decorated with skeletal body paint, dark ear spools, and stylized symbols of death. Framing the court are decorative Maya glyph borders and vibrant green maize stalks sprouting from the floor.
07-tro-og-ritualer#3.caption: Heltetvillingerne Hunahpu og Xbalanque spiller det hellige boldspil mod underverdenens dødsherrer i Xibalba.
07-tro-og-ritualer#3.alt: Maya-kodekstegning af heltetvillingerne, der spiller boldspil mod dødsherrerne.

07-tro-og-ritualer#2.heading: Guderne
07-tro-og-ritualer#2.motif: In the two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya screenfold codex on bark paper, a scene depicts prominent deities framed by decorative red borders and day glyphs. The wise creator god Itzamnaaj is depicted as an elderly figure with a large ornate headdress and toothless mouth, seated on a glyphic throne. Next to him, the rain god Chaak appears with a distinctive downward-curling nose, holding a lightning axe aloft. Nearby, the youthful Maize God rises gracefully, his elongated head merging into sprouting corn stalks. The palette features classic Maya blue, terracotta red, yellow ochre, and strong black ink outlines.
07-tro-og-ritualer#2.caption: Maya-guderne Itzamnaaj, regnguden Chaak og den unge majsgud afbildet i klassisk Maya-kodeksstil.
07-tro-og-ritualer#2.alt: En malet Maya-kodeksside der viser guderne Itzamnaaj, Chaak og majsguden.

07-tro-og-ritualer#1.heading: Verden i lag
07-tro-og-ritualer#1.motif: The Maya cosmos as a vertical codex diagram: a great green ceiba world tree in the center, its crown reaching into a layered sky band with sun, moon and stars, its roots reaching down into a dark watery underworld (Xibalba) with skulls and bones; around the tree, four colored directions shown only as colored blocks and small trees: red in the east, white in the north, black in the west, yellow in the south; a small figure stands at the green center. No letters, no compass labels.
07-tro-og-ritualer#1.caption: Verdenstræet forbinder himlen, menneskenes verden og underverdenen Xibalba. Verdenshjørnerne har hver sin farve.

08-viden#7.heading: Øjne på himlen
08-viden#7.motif: A Maya astronomer-priest standing on top of a temple platform at dawn, sighting along two crossed wooden sticks held at eye level towards the rising sun and the bright morning star Venus above a distant temple on the horizon; a second priest sits with an open screenfold codex recording the observation. Jungle canopy below. No tubes, no telescopes, no guns.
08-viden#7.caption: En maya-astronom sigter med to krydsede pinde mod solopgangen og Venus, mens en skriver noterer i en foldebog.
08-viden#7.alt: Astronom på et tempel sigter mod solopgangen og Venus

08-viden#6.heading: Den lange kalender
08-viden#6.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and earthy Maya blue and red washes, a high-ranking daykeeper sits cross-legged on a woven reed mat. He holds a fine brush, carefully painting intricate calendrical glyph blocks representing time units onto a long, folding bark paper manuscript. Beside him stands a tall stone stela carved with stacked vertical calendar glyphs under a celestial sky band adorned with stars. The scene conveys the cosmic expanse of Maya time cycles, bridging distant past skyscapes with future epochs.
08-viden#6.caption: En maya-skriver nedfælder den lange kalenders tidsenheder på barkpapir foran en udskåret stenstøtte i et tempel.
08-viden#6.alt: Maya-skriver maler kalenderglyffer på barkpapir foran en monumental stensøjle.

08-viden#5.heading: Tre kalendere på én gang
08-viden#5.motif: A Maya astronomer-priest sits cross-legged on a low stone platform covered in a jaguar pelt. He wears an elaborate feathered headdress and jade ear spools, holding a stylus made of bone over an open deer-hide codex. Before him, two large interlocking circular diagrams represent the sacred Tzolk'in and the solar Haab' calendars, filled with intricate Maya day glyphs and dots. Behind the priest, stylized obsidian stars hang from a decorative celestial sky band. The artwork follows the ancient codex style with bold black outlines, earthy red and Maya blue washes on a warm parchment-colored background.
08-viden#5.caption: En maya-astronom studerer sammenkoblingen af den hellige 260-dages kalender og solåret.
08-viden#5.alt: En maya-præst sidder foran to indbyrdes forbundne kalenderhjul i kodeksstil.

08-viden#4.heading: Tal og nul
08-viden#4.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex on weathered bark paper, a Maya scribe sits cross-legged on a woven reed mat. He wears a simple cloth loincloth, jade wrist beads, and a tight headwrap with a writing quill tucked behind his ear. Before him lies a folded screen-fold book. With a fine brush dipped in black ink from a carved shell inkwell, he paints the traditional Maya numerical symbols: a single dot, a solid horizontal bar, and a stylized spiral seashell representing zero. Decorative Maya glyphs border the warm ochre and Maya-blue scene.
08-viden#4.caption: En maya-skriver sidder på en sivmåtte og nedskriver talsymbolerne for én, fem og nul.
08-viden#4.alt: Maya-skriver maler talsymbolerne for prik, streg og nul-skal på barkpapir.

08-viden#3.heading: Hvordan skriften blev knækket
08-viden#3.motif: A Maya ruler in elaborate ceremonial costume, wearing a quetzal-feather headpiece, jade jewelry, and a patterned loincloth, stands in profile beside a carved stone stela. On the stela, carved glyphs depict key moments of royal life: a newborn infant wrapped in cloth, a coronation with a crown being placed on a king's head, and an ancestral spirit. A seated Maya scribe wearing a simple cotton tunic holds a brush pen and a folding bark-paper codex, painting glyphic signs representing syllables and royal history. The scene is framed by a traditional codex red border against a warm, aged parchment background.
08-viden#3.caption: En maya-konge står ved en stela, der viser begivenheder i hans liv, mens en skriver nedfælder historien.
08-viden#3.alt: En maya-hersker og en skriver ved en udskåret stenstela i kodexstil.

08-viden#2.heading: Bøgerne, der blev brændt
08-viden#2.motif: In the open stone plaza of Maní, rendered in the classic Maya codex art style, a solemn scene unfolds under a tropical sky. A Spanish friar in dark monastic robes stands beside a crackling bonfire constructed from folding bark-paper books. Flames consume the accordion-folded codices, which feature painted red and black glyphic panels. To the side, a Maya scribe dressed in a woven tunic, waistcloth, and jade ear ornaments stands in shadow, holding a single folded manuscript tightly against his chest to save it from the blaze. In the background, low stone platforms of Yucatecan architecture frame the burning of these precious Maya histories.
08-viden#2.caption: Biskop Diego de Landa lader mayabøger brænde i Maní, mens en maya-skriver forsøger at redde et manuskript.
08-viden#2.alt: En munk står ved et bål af brændende mayabøger, mens en maya gemmer en bog.

08-viden#1.heading: Hieroglyfferne
08-viden#1.motif: Inside a vaulted Maya palace room, an ancient scribe sits cross-legged on a low plaster bench, working on an accordion-folded bark paper manuscript. The scribe wears a traditional woven cotton loincloth, jade ear spools, and a wrapped turban holding fine hair brushes. With a delicate brush made of animal hair, the scribe carefully paints intricate hieroglyphic blocks in rich red and black inks onto the smooth, white-lime-coated paper. Beside the manuscript sit small ceramic pots containing natural mineral pigments. In the background, carved stone wall reliefs display glyph panels, lit by natural daylight entering through a high arched doorway.
08-viden#1.caption: En maya-skriver sidder i sit værksted og maler sirlige hieroglyffer på et folde-ud manuskript af barkpapir.
08-viden#1.alt: En mayaskriver maler røde og sorte hieroglyffer på et foldet ark barkpapir.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#7.heading: Malede bægre og små figurer
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#7.motif: Inside a brightly lit Maya workshop, a skilled Maya artisan kneels on a woven reed mat, holding a delicate brush. He carefully paints red and black fine-line figures and hieroglyphs onto a tall cream-colored ceramic cylinder vessel resting on a low wooden stand. Beside his work area, several small clay figurines are displayed: a noble warrior holding a woven shield, a woman weaving on a backstrap loom, and a respected elder in a folded headdress. Decorative Maya glyph cartouches border the scene, framing the craftsman surrounded by his finished vessels and detailed figurines.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#7.caption: En maya-kunstner maler et cylinderbæger i kodeks-stil ved siden af støbte lerfigurer af krigere og vævere.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#7.alt: En mayakunstner maler et lerbæger, mens små figurer står ved siden af.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#6.heading: Jade – mere værd end guld
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#6.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and rich earthy pigments, a Maya craftsman sits on a reed mat inside a workshop. He wears a simple cloth loincloth and works patiently, using a taut cord coated with wet sand abrasive to cut a block of deep green jade. Beside him on a raised stone pedestal, a majestic king's burial mask made of mosaic jade tesserae is displayed, complete with gleaming white shell and dark obsidian eyes. Surrounding the mask are polished jade bead necklaces and large ear spools. Decorative Mayan glyphs border the frame.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#6.caption: En maya-håndværker sliber den værdifulde jade, ved siden af en kongelig dødsmaske sammensat af jademosaik.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#6.alt: En maya-håndværker der former jade overfor en færdig kongelig jademaske.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#5.heading: Mayablå
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#5.motif: Drawn in the flat, stylized two-dimensional aesthetic of an ancient Maya codex, a Maya artisan kneeling in profile prepares the legendary Maya blue pigment. He mixes blue indigo dye from indigo leaves with pale palygorskite clay inside a shallow ceramic basin placed over a small, smoking clay brazier. Nearby, finished turquoise-blue pigment coats an ornate ceramic offering bowl and sacred rain god figurines. The background features decorative Mayan sky bands and rain glyphs. The artisan wears a traditional embroidered loincloth, woven headband, and jade ear spools. The color palette relies heavily on rich Maya blue, ochre, and terracotta tones.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#5.caption: En maya-håndværker fremstiller den holdbare pigment mayablå ved at varme indigo og ler sammen over ild.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#5.alt: En maya-håndværker blander indigo og ler over ild i klassisk codex-stil.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#4.heading: Bonampak – et hof i farver
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#4.motif: A royal Maya court scene inside a painted palace structure, rendered in ancient Maya codex style. On a raised plastered bench covered in jaguar pelts, a noble ruler and royal attendant present a young heir wrapped in fine cotton cloth to gathered lords. The nobles wear towering quetzal feather headdresses, jade ear spools, and embroidered loincloths. To the side, a procession of musicians plays long wooden trumpets and tall upright hand drums. Rich Maya blue and iron-red pigments saturate the painted walls and backdrop. Stylized painted glyphs accent the upper borders of the scene.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#4.caption: Et Maya-hof med fyrstelige herskere og musikere med trompeter og trommer, malet i klassisk Maya-blå.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#4.alt: Mayakongelige og musikere fremstillet i farverig kodexstil i et paladskammer.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#3.heading: Stelaer og trapper med tekst
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#3.motif: In the central plaza of Copán, a Maya ruler wearing an elaborate quetzal feather headdress, jade ear spools, and a woven ceremonial loincloth stands next to a high-relief limestone stela. The stela depicts a king emerging dramatically in three dimensions from the stone column. Behind him, the monumental Hieroglyphic Stairway stretches up the side of a grand pyramid, its broad stone steps covered in carved glyphic panels. A stone sculptor works on the lower steps of the staircase under the sun. The scene is rendered in an authentic Maya codex style with black outlines, Maya blue, and terracotta tones.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#3.caption: En maya-konge står ved sin udskårne stela foran den monumentale Hieroglyftrappe i Copán.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#3.alt: En mayakonge ved en udskåret stensøjle foran en stejl trappe med glyffer.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#2.heading: Byens plan
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#2.motif: In the flat, stylized artistic tradition of a Maya codex, a grand ceremonial center unfolds. At the center stands a high stepped pyramid temple with a doorway fashioned as the gaping jaw of an earth deity, symbolizing a sacred cave. Next to the temple, a wide plaza connects an I-shaped ball court and a low palace with stone screens. Raised stone causeways extend from the plaza outward into lush maize gardens dotted with small thatched dwellings. A Maya noble wearing a patterned loincloth and a towering feather headdress stands on a platform, gesturing toward the city layout.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#2.caption: Et mayacenter med et pyramidetempel som et helligt bjerg, en central plads og hævede veje til omverdenen.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#2.alt: Mayaby i codex-stil med pyramide, plads og hævede veje.

09-kunst-og-arkitektur#1.heading: Byggeri uden buer og hjul
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#1.motif: Maya masons and laborers construct a towering limestone temple in the ancient codex style. In the foreground, a builder kneels wearing a simple loincloth, using a hard stone tool to shape a block of pale limestone. Another worker carries a heavy cut stone on his back using a cotton tumpline wrapped around his forehead. Above them, craftsmen assemble a high, narrow interior room featuring a corbeled vault, showing the stepping stone layers that incline inward to meet at a flat capstone. In the background, the topped pyramid temple sports a soaring, sculpted roof comb painted in rich red ochre and white stucco, set against stylized sky scrolls and tropical trees.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#1.caption: Maya-håndværkere opfører et tempel med falsk hvælving og bærer tunge kalksten på ryggen.
09-kunst-og-arkitektur#1.alt: Maya-bygningsarbejdere hugger sten ud og opfører en falsk hvælving i et tempel.

10-kollapset#6.heading: Folket forsvandt ikke
10-kollapset#6.motif: Rendered in two-dimensional Maya codex style with red borders and faux glyphs at the top, a procession of Maya families travels along a path lined with kapok trees toward a distant stone pyramid near a clear lake. The travelers carry woven baskets, clay jars, and wrapped bundles on their backs. A leader wearing a simple feathered headdress points toward the rising stone temple of a new city in the north. The scene uses traditional earth tones, Maya blue, and strong black outlines to symbolize migration, hope, and the continuation of Maya civilization.
10-kollapset#6.caption: Maya-familier vandrer mod nye byer i nord som Chichén Itzá og Uxmal med deres ejendele.
10-kollapset#6.alt: Mayaer på vandring mod nye byer og søer i et klassisk kodeks-design.

10-kollapset#5.heading: Kongerne mistede magten
10-kollapset#5.motif: Rendered in the two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines, a divine Maya king stands atop a stepped stone temple platform under a harsh, cloudless ochre sky. The king wears a grand quetzal-feather headdress, a carved jade pectoral, and an embroidered loincloth, holding a ceremonial serpent scepter. In the courtyard below, commoners and farmers clad in simple cotton tunics turn away or look up with frustration instead of worship. Beside the plaza, fields of withered, yellowed maize droop in the cracked earth. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top edge of the scene, rendered in traditional pigments of Maya blue, terracotta red, and warm yellow.
10-kollapset#5.caption: En maya-konge står på sit tempel, mens folket nedenfor mister troen på hans magt under tørken.
10-kollapset#5.alt: En maya-konge på et tempel overfor utilfredse bønder ved visnede marker.

10-kollapset#4.heading: Krig
10-kollapset#4.motif: Rendered in an ancient Maya codex style, this scene illustrates escalating warfare during the Classic collapse. Maya warriors wearing quilted cotton armor, elaborate jaguar pelts, and feather headpieces stand atop a newly constructed defensive wooden palisade built around a limestone temple plaza. Below, a victorious Maya lord holding a spear receives bound high-ranking captives with stripped regalia. In the background, smoke rises from damaged, neglected maize fields, while fleeing villagers carrying woven bundles walk along a trail. Decorative Maya glyph blocks line the upper border, framing the scene with flat two-dimensional codex artistry, warm earthen tones, and bold black outlines.
10-kollapset#4.caption: Maya-krigere forsvarer en by med nyligt opførte træpalisader, mens bundne krigsfanger bringes for en konge.
10-kollapset#4.alt: Maya-krigere på en forsvarsmur og bundne krigsfanger foran en tempelpyramide.

10-kollapset#3.heading: For mange mennesker og for lidt skov
10-kollapset#3.motif: Rendered in an authentic ancient Maya codex style with strong black outlines on textured bark paper. In the foreground, Maya men in simple loincloths cut down rain-forest trees with stone axes, while others carry wood logs toward a smoking kiln pit covered in white lime dust. In the background, deforested brown hillsides show thin topsoil washing away under stylized rain streams. Beside the eroding slope, a small maize field features withered, drooping corn stalks. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top of the scene between traditional red border lines.
10-kollapset#3.caption: Maya-bønder fælder skov til brænde og kalkbrænding, mens regnen skyller den bare jord væk fra markerne.
10-kollapset#3.alt: Tegning i codex-stil af skovrydning, kalkbrænding og jorderosion i Maya-riget.

10-kollapset#2.heading: Tørke
10-kollapset#2.motif: Drawn in an ancient Maya codex style with dark outlines and earthy pigments, a Maya ruler and a priest stand at the edge of a dried-up reservoir, its plaster-lined basin cracked with white gypsum deposits showing where water has completely evaporated. In the background, wilted, yellowing maize stalks droop in parched soil beneath a burning, stylized sun glyph. The priest, wearing a traditional woven loincloth and small feather headpiece, holds up a decorated ceramic offering bowl toward a carved rain glyph, while the ruler looks down in dismay at the bone-dry reservoir bed.
10-kollapset#2.caption: En maya-præst og hersker ved et udtørret reservoir med visnende majsplanter under en alvorlig tørke.
10-kollapset#2.alt: En maya-præst kigger på et udtørret vandreservoir og visnende majs i codex-stil.

10-kollapset#1.heading: Ikke en katastrofe, men en lang nedtur
10-kollapset#1.motif: In an ancient Maya codex illustration style, a Maya stone sculptor's workshop in front of a half-carved limestone stela lies silent and abandoned. The stela features intricately outlined glyphs and a royal relief, but large sections remain rough and unfinished. Stone chisels, flint blades, and wooden mallets sit scattered on a woven mat at the base of the monument. In the background, thick jungle vines begin to climb the steep stone steps of a nearby pyramid temple under a muted sky, symbolizing the slow, quiet abandonment of the great Classic Maya cities during the collapse.
10-kollapset#1.caption: Et ufuldendt stensøjlemonument står forladt med mejsler og værktøj tilbage i skyggen af en jungleovergroet pyramide.
10-kollapset#1.alt: Et halvfærdigt Maya-stenmonument og efterladt værktøj foran en overgroet pyramide.

11-postklassisk-tid#5.heading: Højlandets kongeriger
11-postklassisk-tid#5.motif: In the Guatemalan highlands, framed by steep pine-covered mountains, a K'iche' Maya ruler sits on a jaguar-pelt throne atop a stone platform in Q'umarkaj. He wears a grand headdress of sweeping quetzal feathers, a patterned woven tunic, and polished jade ornaments. Beside him, a noble scribe holds an open screenfold codex painted with stylized glyphs, evoking the preservation of the sacred Popol Vuh. Drawn in a two-dimensional Postclassic Maya codex style, the scene uses strong black outlines, warm ochre and red washes, and flat decorative background elements.
11-postklassisk-tid#5.caption: En K'iche'-konge og hans skriver i højlandets hovedstad Q'umarkaj, hvor historierne til Popol Vuh blev bevaret.
11-postklassisk-tid#5.alt: En majakonge på trone sammen med en skriver i Guatemalas bjergrige højland.

11-postklassisk-tid#4.heading: Handel langs kysten
11-postklassisk-tid#4.motif: In the distinct visual style of a Postclassic Maya codex, a large wooden trade canoe glides through turquoise coastal waters beneath the fortified stone cliff of Tulum. Inside the canoe, Maya traders wearing cotton loincloths, nose ornaments, and simple headdresses navigate near the shore. The canoe is filled with woven baskets containing jade beads, raw obsidian blades, bundled cotton textiles, and small golden bells. On the limestone cliff above, the walled city of Tulum stands with its characteristic flat-roofed temples and painted facade. In the background, sea waves ripple beneath stylized Maya clouds and decorative celestial glyphs, depicting active maritime trade along the Caribbean coast of Yucatan.
11-postklassisk-tid#4.caption: Maya-handlende sejler i kano med varer som jade, bomuld og guldklokker forbi Tulums kystby.
11-postklassisk-tid#4.alt: En maya-kano fyldt med handelsvarer sejler på havet foran Tulums klippeby.

11-postklassisk-tid#3.heading: Mayapán
11-postklassisk-tid#3.motif: In the flat landscape of northern Yucatán, framed by the long stone defensive wall of Mayapán, a council of noble Maya lords gathers upon woven mats. Rendered in the flat graphic style of a Postclassic Maya codex, the lords wear embroidered cotton mantles, jade necklaces, and ornate feather headdresses. They confer before the central step-pyramid, a smaller architectural twin of El Castillo with stepped tiers and an upper sanctuary. Low thatched-roof elite residences stand close together nearby, highlighting the densely populated city. Decorative Maya glyphs line the upper border of the composition, depicting the shared rule of noble lineages in Mayapán.
11-postklassisk-tid#3.caption: Et råd af adelsmænd samlet foran Mayapáns centralpyramide, omgivet af byens mure.
11-postklassisk-tid#3.alt: Maya-adelsmænd siddende i råd foran en trappepyramide og en bymur i Mayapán.

11-postklassisk-tid#2.heading: Chichén Itzá
11-postklassisk-tid#2.motif: In the flat landscape of northern Yucatán, the grand step pyramid El Castillo dominates the scene under an afternoon sun. An undulating shadow along the main staircase connects to a carved stone serpent head at the base, creating the visual effect of the deity Kukulkan descending. Standing near the base are Maya warriors depicted in profile in classic Postclassic codex style, wearing padded cotton armor, carrying feathered shields and spearthrowers. Stone reliefs of prowling jaguars and eagles consume hearts on nearby platforms. The artwork uses bold black outlines, rich Maya blue, ochre, and deep red tones on weathered bark paper texture, flanked by decorative Maya day glyphs.
11-postklassisk-tid#2.caption: Pyramiden El Castillo i Chichén Itzá med fjerklædte slanger, krigere og udskårne relieffer af jaguarer og ørne.
11-postklassisk-tid#2.alt: El Castillo-pyramiden i Chichén Itzá med krigere og slangesymboler i maya-kodeksstil.

11-postklassisk-tid#1.heading: Uxmal og Puuc-bjergene
11-postklassisk-tid#1.motif: In the distinctive red and yellow palette of an ancient Maya codex, Maya stonemasons adjust limestone mosaic blocks on the upper frieze of a grand Puuc-style palace in Uxmal. The lower walls are smooth, contrasting sharply with the intricate upper facade featuring geometric lattice patterns and stacked stone masks of the rain god Chaak with long, hooked snouts. A Maya nobleman in embroidered textiles and a feather headdress stands in profile, offering a ceramic bowl beneath a stylized sky band with rain motifs. The rolling green Puuc hills curve gently in the background.
11-postklassisk-tid#1.caption: En Puuc-bygning i Uxmal prydet med mosaikmønstre og stenhuggede masker af regnguden Chaak.
11-postklassisk-tid#1.alt: Maya-bygning i Uxmal med udskårne Chaak-regngudsmasker og mosaikfrise.

12-spanierne-kommer#8.heading: Mayaerne lever videre
12-spanierne-kommer#8.motif: Drawn in the flat, two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex with strong outlines. A Maya scribe sits cross-legged inside a simple thatched-roof dwelling, dressed in a traditional embroidered cotton loincloth and jade ear spools. He works carefully, writing with an ink quill on European paper to preserve his people's sacred stories in the Latin alphabet. Next to him on a woven mat lies an open accordion-fold Maya screenfold book decorated with vibrant painted deities and Maya glyphs. Through the doorway, the simple bell tower of a Spanish mission church is visible in the distance under a tropical sky.
12-spanierne-kommer#8.caption: En maya-skriver nedskriver sine forfædres myter med latinske bogstaver ved siden af en traditionel kodeks.
12-spanierne-kommer#8.alt: En maya-skriver sidder i sit hus og nedskriver gamle historier på papir.

12-spanierne-kommer#7.heading: Det sidste mayarige
12-spanierne-kommer#7.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex with bold black outlines and earthy pigments, Spanish conquistadors launch a naval assault on Lake Petén Itzá. On the stylized blue water, a wooden Spanish brigantine with sails unfurled fires cannons, emitting puffs of smoke. Facing the vessel are Itza Maya warriors in dug-out canoes, wearing quilted cotton armor and vibrant quetzal-feathered headdresses, holding obsidian spears and woven shields. In the background rises the island city of Nojpetén, featuring limestone step-pyramids and thatched roof temples framed by lush Petén rainforest trees. Decorative sky glyphs border the top of the scene.
12-spanierne-kommer#7.caption: Spanierne angriber itza-folkets ø-hovedstad Nojpetén på Petén Itzá-søen i 1697.
12-spanierne-kommer#7.alt: Et spansk skib angriber maya-krigere i kanoer på søen foran Nojpetén.

12-spanierne-kommer#6.heading: Bøgerne brændes
12-spanierne-kommer#6.motif: In a town plaza flanked by Maya stone structures and an early colonial chapel, a bonfire consumes a stack of screenfold bark-paper codices and carved wooden deity idols. On the left, a Franciscan friar, representing Diego de Landa in his dark habit, gestures sternly toward the flames. Opposite him, a Maya nobleman in a patterned cotton tunic and simple jade earspools looks on with a somber expression. Bright orange flames and stylized smoke swirls rise from the burning manuscripts. The scene is depicted in the traditional two-dimensional Maya codex art style, rendered with bold red and blue pigments and framed by decorative Maya glyphs.
12-spanierne-kommer#6.caption: Munken Diego de Landa overværer afbrændingen af mayaernes foldebøger og gudefigurer på pladsen i Maní.
12-spanierne-kommer#6.alt: Maya-foldebøger og træfigurer brænder på en plads foran en spansk munk.

12-spanierne-kommer#5.heading: Yucatán
12-spanierne-kommer#5.motif: In an ancient Maya codex style, Spanish conquistadors wearing steel morion helmets and armor stand beside Maya laborers carrying carved limestone blocks. The scene depicts the dismantling of a Maya step pyramid at T'ho to construct the foundation of a Spanish cathedral. Maya workers in traditional cotton loincloths and feather ornaments hoist heavy stones with ropes, while Spanish figures hold banners. The art uses flat two-dimensional perspectives, strong black outlines, and traditional Maya pigments of ochre, terracotta red, and Maya blue. Decorative glyph blocks line the top margin.
12-spanierne-kommer#5.caption: Spanske conquistadorer og mayaer ved opførelsen af domkirken i Mérida med sten fra templet i T'ho.
12-spanierne-kommer#5.alt: Spaniere og mayaer bygger domkirke af genbrugte tempelsten i Mérida.

12-spanierne-kommer#4.heading: Højlandet erobres
12-spanierne-kommer#4.motif: In the flat, two-dimensional style of a Maya codex, Spanish conquistador Pedro de Alvarado, clad in steel breastplate and helmet with a drawn sword, stands beside his indigenous Mexican allies in padded cotton armor. Facing them are K'iche' Maya lords adorned in elaborate quetzal-feather headdresses and jade ear spools, standing near a stylized step-pyramid temple engulfed in orange codex-style flames, representing the capital Q'umarkaj. Pine trees and volcanic peaks of the Guatemalan highlands line the background, painted with bold black outlines and rich pigments of Maya blue, yellow, and red. Decorative Maya glyphs border the top of the scene.
12-spanierne-kommer#4.caption: Spanske conquistadorer og deres mexicanske allierede konfronterer K'iche'-herskerne foran den brændende by Q'umarkaj.
12-spanierne-kommer#4.alt: Spanske soldater og Maya-herskere foran et brændende tempel i Maya-kodeksstil.

12-spanierne-kommer#3.heading: Sygdommene kom først
12-spanierne-kommer#3.motif: Drawn in the distinctive two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex, a tragic scene unfolds inside a traditional thatched Maya house. A Maya woman kneels beside a family member resting on a woven reed mat, holding an earthenware incense burner that emits soft curls of smoke. Outside the open doorway, stylized wind motifs and dark glyph-like clouds sweep over a tropical jungle landscape, symbolizing the invisible spread of European diseases. The figures wear simple cotton garments and jade beads, portrayed with weary postures and closed eyes to convey illness without graphic gore. Decorative Maya calendar glyphs line the upper border.
12-spanierne-kommer#3.caption: En maya-familie ramt af sygdom plejes i hjemmet, mens ukendte epidemier spreder sig i området.
12-spanierne-kommer#3.alt: En syg maya-familie ligger på måtter i et hus i maya-kodexstil.

12-spanierne-kommer#2.heading: Skibbrudne
12-spanierne-kommer#2.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex on textured bark paper, the scene depicts the contrasting fates of the two shipwrecked Spaniards in Yucatán. Gonzalo Guerrero stands as a Maya war leader, adorned with intricate facial tattoos, jade ear spools, a woven feather mantle, and a decorated loincloth. Beside him stands his Maya noble wife holding their young child. On the opposite side, Jerónimo de Aguilar is shown in simple captive attire, holding a woven basket. In the background, stylized stone temples rise near a turquoise coast where a distant Spanish ship floats. Decorative Maya glyphs frame the top border.
12-spanierne-kommer#2.caption: Gonzalo Guerrero lever som mayakriger med sin familie, mens Jerónimo de Aguilar lever som slave på Yucatán.
12-spanierne-kommer#2.alt: Gonzalo Guerrero i mayadragt med sin familie og Jerónimo de Aguilar ved kysten.

12-spanierne-kommer#1.heading: Det første møde
12-spanierne-kommer#1.motif: A scene in the flat two-dimensional style of an ancient Maya codex, painted on aged bark paper with bold black outlines and natural pigments. A large Maya trading canoe glides across stylized turquoise ocean waters filled with sea life glyphs. The long canoe features a central palm-thatched canopy shelter and is manned by Maya traders wearing patterned loincloths and feather-adorned headbands. Inside the boat are detailed trade goods: ceramic jars brimming with cacao beans, folded dyed cotton fabrics, polished copper axes, and wooden swords lined with sharp black obsidian blades. On the horizon, a stylized Spanish caravel with tall sails and bearded soldiers in iron helmets approaches.
12-spanierne-kommer#1.caption: En stor mayahandelskano fyldt med kakaobønner, tekstiler og obsidian-våben møder et spansk skib ud for kysten.
12-spanierne-kommer#1.alt: En lang maya-handelskano med varer møder et spansk skib i codex-stil.

13-mayaerne-i-dag#6.heading: Hvem ejer fortiden?
13-mayaerne-i-dag#6.motif: In the flat, red-bordered framing of an ancient Maya codex, a traditional Maya elder wearing a intricately patterned woven tunic and feathered headband stands atop a painted limestone platform. He gracefully receives a radiant jade mask and a carved stone ceremonial vessel from an open, decorated wooden chest. Beside him, a figure holds an official painted screenfold scroll adorned with decorative glyphs representing agreement and heritage. In the background, twin stepped pyramids rise under a decorative sky band of astronomical symbols. Painted in terracotta red, deep Maya blue, ochre yellow, and jade green, the scene depicts the rightful stewardship of ancestral treasures.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#6.caption: En mayaleder modtager en hellig jademaske og et udskåret kar som symbol på kulturel ejendomsret.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#6.alt: Mayaleder overdrages hellige genstande foran et tempel i klassisk codex-stil.

13-mayaerne-i-dag#5.heading: Fortiden under skoven
13-mayaerne-i-dag#5.motif: In the flat two-dimensional style of a Maya codex, a dual-layered scene depicts hidden monumental architecture. Above, a thick forest canopy of stylized green palm leaves and vines stretches across the frame, with golden beams of light streaming downward like scanning rays. Beneath the translucent roots and foliage, a sprawling ancient Maya city is revealed, featuring stepped stone pyramids, raised causeways, and terraced fields painted in terracotta and ochre hues. Decorative Maya glyphs framing the scene symbolize trees and stone temples, visually connecting the natural jungle above with the hidden urban landscape buried beneath the soil.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#5.caption: Med ny teknologi afsløres en skjult maya-by med pyramider og veje under regnskovens tætte trækroner.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#5.alt: En maya-by med pyramider træder frem under en tæt regnskov.

13-mayaerne-i-dag#4.heading: Borgerkrigen i Guatemala
13-mayaerne-i-dag#4.motif: A quiet memorial in a Guatemalan highland village: several Maya women in woven huipil blouses and men in modern clothes place white candles, marigold flowers and copal incense in front of a simple wall where many small cloth bundles and flowers are laid; mountains and maize fields behind; a sad, dignified mood. No recognizable real person, no symbols such as peace signs, no weapons, no violence shown.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#4.caption: Mayaer i højlandet mindes ofrene for borgerkrigen med lys, blomster og kopal.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#4.alt: Mayakvinder tænder lys ved et mindested i højlandet

13-mayaerne-i-dag#3.heading: Kastekrigen
13-mayaerne-i-dag#3.motif: Rendered in an ancient Maya codex style with bold black outlines and earthy pigments, a group of 19th-century Yucatec Maya rebels gathers inside a sacred wooden shrine. At the center, a wooden cross draped in embroidered traditional textiles rests upon a stepped stone altar. A Maya leader clad in a white cotton shirt, woven belt, and leather sandals kneels reverently before the cross. Flanking the altar, Maya fighters hold muskets and machetes, while fragrant copal smoke rises from clay censers. Decorative Maya glyph borders frame the top and bottom of the scene.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#3.caption: Mayaoprørere samlet omkring det talende kors i deres helligdom under Kastekrigen på Yucatán.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#3.alt: Mayaoprørere der knæler foran et dekoreret trækors på et alter.

13-mayaerne-i-dag#2.heading: Traditioner, der lever
13-mayaerne-i-dag#2.motif: In the distinct visual style of an ancient Maya codex, a scene depicts enduring traditions against a backdrop of highland mountains and a lush milpa cornfield. On the left, a Maya woman dressed in a patterned huipil sits on the ground, working at a traditional backstrap loom attached to a tree branch. On the right, a traditional daykeeper, an ajq'ij, kneels beside a small stone altar. He burns aromatic copal resin, sending stylized curls of blue smoke upward while consulting glyphic markers representing the sacred two-hundred-and-sixty-day calendar. Decorative day glyphs frame the scene in classic red and black codex borders.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#2.caption: En Maya-kvinde væver på båndvæv, mens en dagtæller brænder kopal og læser kalendertegn.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#2.alt: Kodeksbillede af en vævende maya-kvinde og en dagtæller ved et kopalalter.

13-mayaerne-i-dag#1.heading: Omkring 30 sprog
13-mayaerne-i-dag#1.motif: In the flat, graphic style of an ancient Maya codex, a contemporary Maya woman wearing a finely woven traditional huipil sits on a mat. She points toward a wooden frame carved with decorative Maya glyphs representing speech and learning. Opposite her, two young Maya children sit attentively. Elaborate, swirling speech scrolls embellished with small Maya speech symbols emerge from their mouths, intertwining to represent the vibrant diversity of Mayanean languages being passed down. On a small low wooden bench beside them sits a modern microphone adorned with traditional Maya geometric patterns, representing modern radio broadcasting in indigenous Mayan languages.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#1.caption: En maya-underviser lærer børn et af de mange maya-sprog, mens tale-skriftsruller forbinder generationerne.
13-mayaerne-i-dag#1.alt: En maya-kvinde underviser børn i et maya-sprog i traditionel codex-stil.

14-klar-til-moesgaard#8.heading: Spørgsmål at stille ved hver genstand

14-klar-til-moesgaard#3.heading: De syv jademasker
14-klar-til-moesgaard#3.motif: Drawn in ancient Maya codex style, a Classic Period Maya ruler lies in state inside a stone tomb chamber, adorned with a shining green jade mosaic death mask with inlaid shell and obsidian eyes. He wears large round jade ear ornaments and an intricate jade pectoral over his chest. Attendants in ceremonial loincloths and feather headdresses place stalks of ripe maize beside him to symbolize his spiritual rebirth as the Maize God. Pottery vessels around the bench hold unpolished Motagua jade pebbles and polishing tools. Stylized Maya glyphs line the upper border.
14-klar-til-moesgaard#3.caption: En maya-hersker i sin grav, iført en grøn jademaske og klar til genfødsel som majsgud.
14-klar-til-moesgaard#3.alt: En maya-hersker i sin grav iført en grøn jademaske omgivet af majsplanter.

14-klar-til-moesgaard#1.heading: Slangeriget i korte træk
14-klar-til-moesgaard#1.motif: In the style of an ancient Maya codex, a powerful Maya ruler sits upon a carved stone throne in a ceremonial plaza at Calakmul. He wears an elaborate headdress adorned with vivid green quetzal feathers and a stylized serpent mask, along with heavy jade earrings and a multi-layered jade necklace. In his hands, he holds a ceremonial double-headed serpent bar. Beside the throne stands a massive limestone stele displaying the prominent Kaanul emblem glyph—a detailed snake head wearing a royal headband. Lush jungle foliage and towering step-pyramids frame the scene under a clear sky, rendered with bold black outlines and rich ochre, turquoise, and terracotta tones.
14-klar-til-moesgaard#1.caption: En majakonge på sin trone omgivet af udskårne stensøjler med Slangerigets karakteristiske slangehieroglyf.
14-klar-til-moesgaard#1.alt: Majakonge på trone foran stensøjler med slangehieroglyffen i klassisk codex-stil.
